typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif (tracking-wide for readability)
typography.hierarchy: Headings must use the cosmic gradient (bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-pink-500 to-orange-500). Labels and small text must use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for a technical feel.

visual_enhancers.background_effects: Use react-tsparticles to create a hyperspace warp-speed starfield in the deepest background (z-index: -1). Particles should move towards the viewer to simulate light speed. Add animated planets and chemical asteroid trails using custom images in the particles configuration or CSS animations.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For floating panels (Settings, Plugin Marketplace), use optical crystal clarity: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-white/10. Do not use plain transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadows on active elements (like the current file or active AI chat bubble). Implement gradient borders with glow effects.
visual_enhancers.warp_flash: When generating AI code or switching models, trigger a brief framer-motion full-panel subtle pink/orange flash (opacity 0 to 0.05 then back to 0).
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use a shimmering gradient border (tracing beam style) for active panels or AI typing indicators.

layouts.ide_structure: A high-density grid pattern. Use a split-pane layout (like react-resizable-panels). Left: Explorer, Center: Monaco Editor, Right: AI Chat/Plugin Panel, Bottom: Integrated Terminal.
layouts.spacing: IDE interfaces require tight functional spacing (p-2 to p-4) inside panels, but use generous padding (p-8) for modal overlays and settings pages.
layouts.borders: Expose the skeleton of the IDE. Panels should have strict 1px border-r or border-b using border-white/10. Avoid fully rounded corners on main panels; stick to sharp or 4px (rounded-sm) radii for internal items.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp-edged. Primary actions use the cosmic gradient background. Secondary actions are transparent with border-white/20 and hover to border-pink-500/50.
components.inputs: Cosmic-themed inputs: bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-pink-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-pink-500/50 text-white.
components.cards: Cardless style for the IDE panes. For settings/plugins, use Glassmorphism panels (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl).
components.chat_bubbles: User: bg-white/10 text-white. AI: bg-pink-500/10 border border-pink-500/30 text-pink-50 with code blocks in JetBrains Mono.
components.dropdowns: Model selectors (LM Studio / Ollama) must use Shadcn Select, heavily customized with a dark glass backdrop and hover glows.
components.scrollbars: MUST customize scrollbars globally. Width 6px, track transparent, thumb bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/40 rounded-full.

motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for modal entrances, dropdowns, and AI chat staggered list animations.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on file tree items should slightly translate right (translate-x-1) and change text color to white.
motion.loading: Use an ASCII or simple animated ring with the cosmic gradient for AI thinking states.

3d_libraries.instructions: Install `react-tsparticles` and `tsparticles` (or `tsparticles-engine`). Configure a starfield with high velocity to simulate 'hyperspace' behind the IDE panels. Ensure z-index is lowest so it doesn't block clicks. Include slower, larger particles for animated planets and long-trail particles for chemical asteroid trails.
3d_libraries.config_hint: Use direction: 'none', outModes: 'out', and high speed (min: 15, max: 40) with trails (length: 5) to stretch the stars.

media.icons: Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for high-end feel).

images.description: Galaxy wallpaper - Use as an optional overlay blended (mix-blend-screen, opacity 10%) on the login or welcome screen.
Vibrant abstract artwork evoking a galaxy with blue and pink hues. Good for Plugin Marketplace banners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Use text-shadow to boost legibility over gradients.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Space Grotesk' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headers, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for code.
Do NOT center align the app container in App.css. Let the split panes dictate layout.
Implement the UI as a fully responsive Dark Mode ONLY application.
Use react-resizable-panels for the IDE layout (Explorer, Editor, Chat, Terminal).
Use react-tsparticles for the hyperspace background effect.
The UI must feel like a premium command center: use 1px solid borders with 10% opacity, sharp corners for panes, and localized neon glows for active elements.
Model Selector (LM Studio/Ollama) should be prominently placed in the header or top of the AI chat pane.
Build the Model Management pane with sliders for Temperature and Max Tokens, and options to test the models directly.
Plugin Marketplace should allow browsing and enabling AI plugins, using cards with glassmorphism effects.
universal_guidelines: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Components MUST use named exports; Pages MUST use default exports.
